name: Lillum
source:
The demoness Lillum is one of the baddest bitches in town with an array of lesser demon minions. She's hot-headed, impatient, and not terribly easy to cooperate with. She's used to making all decisions herself. Lillum prefers to play by the rules, but still has the heart of a villain. As far as she’s concerned, kidnapping people? Not a problem. Choosing to kidnap her and making her go through this hassle? That's a problem.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=43343]Lemma Soft Forum thread[/url]]
